subject: HealthGrid integration: MAP draft & integration commitments

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Shaw <emma.shaw@healthgrid.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-02-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: MAP draft + suggested integration commitments

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for a productive conversation this morning — appreciate you walking us through HealthGrid's integration priorities. Per our call, I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP-Draft-HealthGrid-v1.docx) that translates our conversation into milestones, tentative owners, and a target close window. High-level items we captured:

- Integration milestone: SDK integration & streaming proof-of-concept (owner: Connor O'Brien) — target: 6 weeks from kickoff
- Integration milestone: Tool-calling workflow (owner: Connor & Engineering) — target: 8 weeks
- Integration milestone: Structured outputs & validation (owner: HealthGrid / Redwood SE) — target: 10 weeks
- Security/compliance dependency: HealthGrid security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence (owner: HealthGrid) — blocks production sign-off
- Procurement/legal: contract redlines and SLA confirmation (owner: HealthGrid procurement) — target close: EOM Mar 2027 (TBD)

Requested next steps (proposed):
1) You review the MAP draft and confirm owners/priority changes (reply by Tue 2027-02-16)
2) Connor to schedule a 60-min technical kickoff to align SDK & streaming expectations (propose Wed/Thu next week)
3) HealthGrid security team to share the updated questionnaire and residency constraints (link to checklist attached)
4) Jordan/Aditya to coordinate procurement items and send initial SOW/commercial summary

If these look OK I’ll update the MAP and lock a kickoff time. I also attached a short SDK scope doc (sdk-integration-scopes.pdf) that lists the streaming API surface and recommended structured output schema.

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

Vanessa —

Thanks for the recap and the draft MAP. Quick notes from our side after internal alignment:

Emma / Vanessa —

Thanks for the notes. A few technical clarifications so we can lock owners and timelines:

1) Data residency: we support routing test workloads to an EU tenant for staging. That will require a separate deployment of ephemeral dedicated capacity for the POC. Impact: adds 1 week to POC infra setup (I’ll include in the MAP).

2) SDK & streaming surface: the attached sdk-integration-scopes.pdf lists endpoints we intend to use: /generate/stream, /chat/stream, and a separate tool-calling webhook pattern. For HealthGrid’s structured outputs we propose a JSON schema v1.0 (example in doc). Key ask: can your engineering team provide typical max prompt length and expected concurrent sessions (estimate) so we can right-size batching and KV cache config?

3) Tool calling: we recommend starting with a single canonical tool (patient-record-lookup) for the POC to validate end-to-end latency and auth. Owner: Redwood SE + HealthGrid eng.

4) Testing & validation: propose a short test matrix (unit, integration, perf) — I’ll draft and add to MAP as milestones.

I can run a 60-min kickoff Wed 2027-02-17 10:00-11:00 PT — let me know if that works for HealthGrid.

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai
